We need to produce a single-step retrosynthesis route for the given SMILES. Likely the forward reaction is carbonyl-ene forming a cyclopentanol with fluorinated carbonyl? The target: [CH2]=[C]([c]1... ) [C@@H]1[CH2][CH2][CH2][C@@]1([OH]) [C]([F])([F])[F]. This looks like a bicyclic? Actually it's a cyclopentanol fused to aromatic? The carbonyl-ene would start from a ketone (maybe a cyclopentanone with CF3) and an alkene (aryl-substituted exocyclic alkene). The retrosynthesis: break the C-O bond (alcohol) to carbonyl, break C-C bond formed in ene, generate alkene and carbonyl.
